tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations are consistent with a concave base but do not identify the onset or strength of the stated supercritical avalanche. Acquire the targeted high-gradient probe before fitting the threshold model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reaches s_grad=2.44 in the explicitly uncertified supercritical gray zone, so it cannot identify whether a threshold avalanche emerges beyond the observed range.
The unresolved mechanism is the high-gradient threshold, not temporal resolution; the targeted high-s_grad probe is cheaper and directly discriminating.
